caption:
Webb's mirror is nearly 3 times wider than Hubble's. Is Webb sharper?

Not at every colour. In infrared, Webb splits 0.077 arcseconds. Hubble in green light splits 0.052.

At 20 micrometres Webb splits only 0.774 arcseconds.
